title: The fox’s discovery

paragraphs: Before they enter the forest, Narion shows the group some magic bracelets. “My fox will go ahead and check the path,” he says. “It can send us a message about what it sees. It only sends a message when there is danger. When the path is safe, it keeps looking and sends nothing.”

"Put on a bracelet to subscribe as an observer. Take it off to unsubscribe. Then you will get no more notifications. The fox will still do its job, and everyone who still wears a bracelet will still get the discovery."

Narion and Dre’Kaar put on their bracelets. Soon, the fox sees danger and sends both of them the same message. Narion plans a safer path. Dre’Kaar gets ready to protect the group. Each person chooses what to do. Later, Narion takes off his bracelet. The next time the fox sees danger, only Dre’Kaar gets its message.
intro.imageAlt: The fox scouting with Narion in the forest
intro.caption: One Subject publishes to many Observers
intro.task: Build a class diagram. Let the fox act as a Subject that notifies each Observer through the Observer interface. The fox does not need to know their concrete classes.
intro.concept: Subject keeps a list of observers and publishes notifications through notify(). The Observer interface defines update(); each concrete observer implements it and decides what to do with the discovery.

classes.label: FoxSubject
classes.description: Looks for danger and keeps a list of observers. When it finds danger, it publishes the discovery through the Observer interface.

fields.label: observers: Observer[]
fields.description: The list of observers that receive the subject’s notifications.

methods.label: attach(o: Observer)
methods.description: Subscribe an observer by adding it to the observers field.

methods.label: detach(o: Observer)
methods.description: Unsubscribe an observer by removing it from the observers field.

methods.label: notify()
methods.description: Publish the current discovery by calling update(discovery) on each attached observer.

methods.label: discoverDanger() · subject logic
methods.description: When the fox finds danger, save what it sees and call notify(). Publish nothing when the path is safe.

classes.label: Observer
classes.description: The shared update(discovery) contract. Every concrete observer implements it to receive notifications.

methods.label: update(discovery) · contract
methods.description: Put this method in the Observer interface. Each concrete observer implements it.

classes.label: NarionObserver
classes.description: Implements Observer. Gets the discovery and helps Narion plan a safer path.

methods.label: update(discovery) · NarionObserver
methods.description: Get the notification and call planRoute() for Narion.

methods.label: planRoute() · business logic
methods.description: Narion uses the message to choose a safer path.

classes.label: DreKaarObserver
classes.description: Implements Observer. Gets the same discovery and helps Dre’Kaar protect the group.

methods.label: update(discovery) · DreKaarObserver
methods.description: Get the notification and call prepareDefense() for Dre’Kaar.

methods.label: prepareDefense() · business logic
methods.description: Dre’Kaar gets ready to protect the group.

hints: Give FoxSubject the observers: Observer[] field and attach(), detach(), notify(), and discoverDanger(). Looking for danger is its subject logic.
Observer is an interface with update(discovery). Each concrete observer implements this method and decides what to do.
FoxSubject keeps a list of Observer. NarionObserver and DreKaarObserver implement Observer. Connect the fox to this interface, not to the concrete classes.
